preconditions.description: The number of nodes N is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly N-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes, both of which are within the range 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of connected components that can be achieved by applying the operation any number of times.
